title: School canteen shortages, central kitchens and food safety
asked: MPs asked about canteen operator shortages, the Central Kitchen Meal Model, food safety after gastroenteritis cases at River Valley and North View Primary Schools, and support for stallholders.
asked_by: Miss Rachel Ong; Mr Fadli Fawzi; Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim; Mr Foo Cexiang; Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat; Ms Eileen Chong Pei Shan; Ms Hany Soh
response: Ms Jasmin Lau said 95% of schools still use individual stallholders, with rentals of $5–$15 per month waived during school holidays. The Central Kitchen Meal Model began as a pilot at Yusof Ishak Secondary School and was extended to 13 additional schools facing stallholder shortages; MOE has no target to scale it to all schools. Central kitchens are SFA-licensed, inspected more frequently, and graded under the Safety Assurance for Food Establishment framework. Investigations into the River Valley and North View gastroenteritis incidents are ongoing, and MOE has contingency protocols including alternative central kitchens and limiting each operator to four or five schools.

left_open: Whether the Government will proactively engage displaced food and beverage operators to mitigate the canteen operator shortage.
Whether the Government will consider incentivising such pivots with stable, low-rental business environments.
Whether the 60 gastroenteritis cases at River Valley Primary School are linked to the Central Kitchen Meal Model.
Whether punitive actions will be taken against the caterer.
Whether central kitchen operators must meet HACCP standards and Japan's three-zone hygiene system.
Whether the Ministry will publish food safety audit results for all such operators.
How many days after adopting the Central Kitchen Meal Model the River Valley outbreak occurred.
What risk assessment framework MOE developed for concentration of food safety risk across multiple school populations.
How MOE has been supporting affected students and their families.
supplementary: Supplementary questions covered parent communication, hygiene reminders, meal variety, hawker stalls, investigation status, and nutrition roles.
